findings.text: blocking: the exclusion clause is appended to a disjunction of five state tests; Cypher binds AND tighter than OR, so it renders as disc OR scn OR exp OR enr OR (rsc AND none(...)) and applies only to the last disjunct. A discovered, scanned, expand-eligible or enrich-eligible row under an excluded prefix is still counted as pending. This defeats the node's stated goal for the aggregate has-work predicate, and imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:1397 already documents that has_pending_work true while claims return nothing makes the phase reset loop forever.

follow-on: this file is outside the node's declared write paths; two assertions were relaxed from "STARTS WITH" not in ... and "prefixes" not in kwargs to weaker substring/set forms to accommodate the new exclusion clause.

follow-on: the stub applies the exclusion as an unconditional row filter, so it cannot observe where in the WHERE clause the predicate sits; the has_pending_work assertion therefore cannot fail on a precedence-induced regression and overstates the coverage the suite gives that site.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the single commit 64a6ed714 against base 126e8030784004a1080c0244204be11a84143407; 10 files, 545 insertions, 52 deletions, mostly the 22-site wiring plus tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names the gate uv run pytest tests/discovery tests/graph/test_path_prefix_filter.py; logs/after_gate.log records exit 0 with 1218 passed against a baseline of 1188, and logs/negative_control.log records the required red with the excluded row still claimed.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is that path and code claims and their has-work predicates skip rows under a facility's exclusion prefixes; the diff wires one exclusion helper at all 22 named sites (imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:214 and following), but has_pending_work does not in fact skip an excluded row.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reports the gate and its result, and discloses the out-of-scope edit and the scope_prefixes/prefixes naming divergence under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The node was fenced to nine paths; the diff stays inside them except tests/discovery/test_code_pipeline.py, which the node was not fenced to write.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_claims_honour_exclusions.py:118 filters by excluded_prefixes irrespective of clause position, so it stays green on the precedence regression the has_pending_work change carries.
justifications.evidence: logs/after_gate.log:1 names revision 64a6ed714 and records 1218 passed exit 0; the done-when's gate is the command that ran and its result is recorded.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:541 places the new helper beside get_exclusion_config_for_facility and adds no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:234 renders ORs before the exclusion AND, so has_pending_work counts an excluded row in four of its five states rather than skipping it.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:562 builds through build_path_prefix_filter (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:283) rather than rendering its own clause, extending the existing owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/discovery/test_code_pipeline.py:1499 was edited although it is outside the node's declared write paths.
